## Post-route / post-synthesis Fmax (Vivado 2025.2, every design measured both ways)

## Per-family activity factor (a separate power calibration, not the default)

Fitted to the 14 post-synthesis core-power rows above: measured mW at 100 MHz ≈ s_family × power index (4 parameters, log least squares). Written to `src/hw_dse/models/power_activity_artix7_vivado-2025.2-m4.yaml`; the default power index is unchanged (activity 0.125 for every family). **Fitted to Vivado's vectorless estimate** (default toggle rate, confidence Low), not to real switching activity.

| family | mW per index unit | implied activity (default 0.125) |
|---|---|---|
| `iterative` | 5.671 | 0.1244 |
| `pipelined` | 5.019 | 0.1101 |
| `pipelined_m` | 5.827 | 0.1278 |
| `unrolled_k` | 7.408 | 0.1625 |

| power model | parameters | RMS log error in-sample | leave-one-out |
|---|---|---|---|
| default index, normalised to the reference design | 0 | 20.6% | — |
| default index × one fitted scale | 1 | 18.8% | 20.4% |
| per-family activity | 4 | 10.2% | 13.9% |

Spearman rank correlation with measured power: default 0.982, per-family 0.991.
